Your comfort, care, and confidence are at the heart of everything we do. We're a family-owned practice that believes visiting the dentist should feel different—more personal, more supportive, and more about you. ​ At Minted Dental, we take the time to get to know you and your goals so we can help you make informed choices about your dental care. Everything we do is aimed at improving your overall health and quality of life. Our caring and professional team is here to support you every step of the way, with honesty, compassion, and a genuine commitment to exceeding your expectations. ​ We offer a full range of services, including general and routine dentistry, specialty treatments, and emergency care. Looking to enhance your smile? Our doctors have a sharp eye for cosmetic detail and are passionate about helping you love your smile. ​ We're proud to serve the Phoenix, Scottsdale, and surrounding communities. We also accept most major insurance plans to make your experience even easier. ​ Ready to experience the Minted Dental difference? Schedule your appointment today. We can't wait to meet you! Schedule Appointment Meet Dr. Onika Patel A lifetime Phoenician, a passion for dentistry, and a drive for perfection. Emergency Care From broken fillings to cracked teeth, we strive to provide urgent care in a timely manner. Cosmetic Dentistry Cosmetic dentistry involves designing your smile that encompasses both artistry and functionality. Invisalign ​ Invisalign is the clear alternative to braces. No metal brackets or wires! Restorative Dentistry Restoring a tooth’s structure and aesthetics back to its optimal shape and health. Holistic Dentistry Looking for a natural approach to dental care? We offer holistic and biologic dentistry for whole-body wellness. Use tab to navigate through the menu items. DENTAL SERVICES It's estimated that nearly 75% of adults in the United States suffer from some level of dental fear. Considering the importance of receiving regular dental care, our practice has been designed to overcome dental anxiety. At Minted Dental we are pleased to offer a calm and relaxing dental experience unlike any other. If you have always put off visiting the dentist because you are fearful or anxious about what the visit will be like, we invite you to join us for a trip to the dentist that is sure to impress. ​ Indulge yourself while ensuring that you are receiving the best  g eneral ,  cosmetic  and  restorative dentistry  available in the area. Our complimentary menu of comfort services such as plush blankets, ceiling TVs, beverage bar, headphones, hot aromatherapy towels, and relaxing music is standard at each of your appointments.
